title: Renovations & alterations
short: Change the layout. Renew the finishes. Make better use of your property.
description: From a room renovation to a larger property transformation, Regardin Construction brings building work and finishing together. Rework an existing layout, open up a doorway or refresh the surfaces that make a space feel complete.
consideration: Share what you want to change, photographs of the existing space and any plans. Structural alterations may need design input and approvals before building starts.

title: Brickwork & boundary walls
short: Boundary walls, second-floor additions and new doorways.
description: Build a new boundary wall, add a second floor or change a doorway. Regardin handles the breaking and building work that gives your property its shape, from masonry alterations to new walls.
consideration: Tell us the wall dimensions or the opening you need, and send plans where available. Foundations, structural design, property boundaries and approvals must suit the site.

title: Interior & exterior painting
short: A single feature wall or a fresh finish across the whole property.
description: Refresh one room, introduce a feature wall or give your whole property a new colour scheme. Regardin provides interior and exterior painting for homes and businesses, with attention to the surfaces as well as the final coat.
consideration: Include photographs of cracks, damp or loose paint along with the areas you want painted. Surface condition and access help establish the preparation and coating requirements.

title: Carpentry, decking & pergolas
short: Timber pergolas, hardwood decks and practical custom carpentry.
description: Make more of your outdoor space with a timber pergola or hardwood deck. Regardin also undertakes carpentry work, including the cabinetry and walk-in closet work shown in the existing portfolio.
consideration: Share the size, intended use and a photograph of the area. Timber choice, supporting structure, exposure and maintenance requirements should be agreed for your project.

title: Concrete work
short: Driveways, concrete slabs, stairs and pool structures.
description: From a driveway to a concrete slab, staircase or pool structure, Regardin undertakes concrete work for practical everyday use and custom designs. The existing portfolio also includes concrete walls and countertops.
items: Pool structures and custom concrete work
consideration: Send dimensions and drawings if available. Ground conditions, drainage, reinforcement and the intended use inform the design; structural work needs appropriate professional input.

title: Plastering, screeds & pool finishes
short: Wall plaster, floor screeds and pool finishes.
description: Complete the walls, floors and pool surfaces around your property. Regardin’s existing portfolio includes pool plastering, scratch plaster and floor screeds alongside building and renovation work.
consideration: Photographs of the existing surface help identify the work. Moisture, cracks, the substrate and the intended finish need assessment before preparation and materials are agreed.

title: Custom projects
short: Bring your idea. Work out how to build it.
description: A custom design does not always fit a standard service list. Regardin’s “Imagination Creation” service starts with your idea and works through the construction details, whether it involves timber, concrete, masonry or a combination of trades.
items: Work combining masonry, timber and concrete
Project ideas developed into an agreed scope
consideration: Bring sketches, reference images or a simple description of the result you want. Feasibility, specialist input, materials and the quoted scope need to be established before work begins.
